knownLimitations: Central Finance registry and public Gateway deployment are complete. Final installed approval callback still requires a device or emulator with an enrolled strong biometric; the no-biometric emulator correctly failed closed after the exact Finance review screen.
Authorized remote Pay receipt smoke is blocked on an operator-provided Pay read credential.
Explorer reports indexer lag and Finance truthfully bounds activity to the latest 100 indexed records.

The Finance consumer envelope and fail-closed UI are tested locally, but Exchange, DEX, Quant and full Economics payload adapters remain unavailable because no canonical owner contract or shared Testnet vector has been accepted.
YNX_FINANCE_CURSOR_SIGNING_KEY must come from shared secret management; rotation intentionally invalidates outstanding pagination cursors.
YNX_FINANCE_OPERATIONS_KEY must be separately secret-managed; metrics are process-scoped, reset on restart and are not yet persisted or integrated with central Monitor alerting.
Finance backups are authenticated but not encrypted; production requires encrypted access-controlled storage, retention approval and an isolated deployed restore drill with measured RTO/RPO.

The high brace-expansion advisory is fixed and both platform bundles pass. Ten moderate uuid advisories remain in Expo/xcode development tooling because npm proposes only an incompatible Expo 46 downgrade; production promotion remains blocked pending an upstream-compatible fix and independent scanning.
The local edge Gateway uses in-memory replay and revocation state; production requires persistent shared storage.
iOS local install is unavailable because this host has CommandLineTools rather than full Xcode; CI Simulator evidence is pending.
The Android APK uses a local test signature and is not a production or store artifact.
The public Web surface remains a signed-out explanatory companion; canonical account sessions are issued through the registered native Finance client and Wallet flow.
